agent.problem: The setup only says that "someone else" remembers the altars. Nothing in the earlier cards makes "children" inferable rather than "enemies" or "prophets," so the blank asks for unheard verse wording by luck instead of testing a meaning the baker can reason out.

agent.problem: The preceding story card reveals only that people keep saying something to Jeremiah and that it is not praise. rule.text: Never ask the baker to guess the next words of a line.

rule.text: One image only. Never blend the comparison with the Bible setting.
